name: Rishikesh
bestTime: February–May and September–November are often pleasant; monsoon river activities may be restricted.
gettingThere: Road from Haridwar/Dehradun; nearest major rail access is Rishikesh; Jolly Grant Airport serves the region.

name: Haridwar
bestTime: October–April is often comfortable; festival dates can be very busy.
gettingThere: Well connected by rail and road; Dehradun airport is the nearest major airport.

name: Dehradun
tagline: A relaxed valley city and gateway to the hills
bestTime: March–June and September–November are commonly pleasant.
gettingThere: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun railway station and road links.

name: Mussoorie
tagline: Mountain viewpoints and colonial-era hill-town walks
bestTime: April–June and September–November; monsoon conditions can affect roads and trails.
gettingThere: Road from Dehradun; nearest rail station and airport are in Dehradun.

name: Nainital
tagline: A lake town surrounded by Kumaon hills
bestTime: March–June and October–November; winter can be cold.
gettingThere: Road from Kathgodam railhead; Pantnagar is the nearest commercial airport.

name: Auli
tagline: High Himalayan views and seasonal snow sports
bestTime: Winter for snow when conditions allow; late spring and autumn for views.
gettingThere: Road to Joshimath then local transfer; check ropeway and road status before travel.

name: Chopta
bestTime: Spring and autumn are popular; winter access may be weather dependent.
gettingThere: Road transfer from Rishikesh/Haridwar via mountain towns; allow flexible travel time.

name: Kedarnath
tagline: A high-altitude pilgrimage in the Garhwal Himalaya
bestTime: Seasonal access; dates, registration, weather and route conditions must be checked officially.
gettingThere: Road to Sonprayag/Gaurikund, then trek or authorized options subject to current rules.

name: Badrinath
tagline: A revered shrine on the Alaknanda River
bestTime: Seasonal access; verify opening dates and road/weather advisories.
gettingThere: Mountain road via Joshimath; road conditions and seasonal access vary.

name: Gangotri
tagline: A pilgrimage town in the upper Bhagirathi valley
bestTime: Seasonal access; snow, landslides and weather can affect travel.
gettingThere: Road journey via Uttarkashi; verify current road and temple status.

name: Yamunotri
tagline: A Himalayan pilgrimage reached on foot
bestTime: Seasonal access; confirm official opening dates and trek conditions.
gettingThere: Road to the trek access area, then a mountain walk; conditions vary.

name: Valley of Flowers
tagline: A seasonal alpine valley known for wildflowers
bestTime: Usually a monsoon-season bloom destination; access depends on official park opening and weather.
gettingThere: Reach Govindghat by road, then trek via Ghangaria; permits and park rules apply.

name: Jim Corbett National Park
tagline: Forest landscapes and regulated wildlife safaris
bestTime: Cooler months are popular; zones and seasonal closures vary.
gettingThere: Road/rail connections via Ramnagar; safari bookings must use official channels.

name: Tehri Lake
tagline: A vast reservoir framed by mountain scenery
bestTime: Season and activity availability vary; follow local safety guidance.
gettingThere: Road transfers from Rishikesh/Dehradun; confirm operators and activity permissions.

name: Lansdowne
tagline: Quiet pine forests and a peaceful hill escape
bestTime: March–June and September–November are often pleasant.
gettingThere: Road access via Kotdwar; check hill-road conditions.

name: Almora
tagline: Kumaon culture, ridgelines and traditional markets
bestTime: March–June and September–November are commonly pleasant.
gettingThere: Road connections from Kathgodam and nearby Kumaon towns.

name: Munsiyari
tagline: Remote mountain scenery and high Himalayan views
bestTime: Spring and autumn often offer clearer conditions; winter can limit access.
gettingThere: Long mountain road journey; plan buffer time and check conditions.

name: Pithoragarh
tagline: A Kumaon valley town and regional base
bestTime: Spring and autumn are often comfortable.
gettingThere: Road access from Kumaon hubs; allow time for mountain routes.

name: Chakrata
tagline: Forest trails, cliffs and quieter mountain scenery
bestTime: April–June and September–November; monsoon trails can be slippery.
gettingThere: Road access from Dehradun; check weather and local access conditions.
